title: The Fez - Extraordinary Events

services.name: corporate event
services.desc: The Fez has built a long-standing reputation for hosting a wide variety of corporate events. Our dedicated team will help you cover every detail when planning your small business meeting or a large corporate celebration. Our venue boasts three rooms and three private upstairs suites to accommodate groups ranging from 20 to over 600 guests. The venue and catering services you choose for a corporate event play a pivotal role in setting the tone for success. Whether it’s a corporate gala, team-building session, conference, or holiday party, our corporate events exceed expectations. Read on to learn more about our event venue, space available, and the types of corporate events we have hosted

services.name: Grand Ballroom
services.desc: The Fez Grand Ballroom is the ideal Western Pennsylvania location for wedding receptions and upscale events. Our elegant ballroom offers a stunning space for formal affairs and lively celebrations. Experience an open and versatile layout that can be customized to suit your event needs. Celebrate your special occasion on a grand scale in a spacious event venue suited for large gatherings. Book your wedding reception, school or sports banquet, or fundraising gala at The Fez Grand Ballroom. It’s the perfect venue for your next special event For smaller events, consider our charming Terrace Room, ideal for 50-160 guests, or the beautifully appointed Balconade Room, which accommodates 150-250
